basic.appPasswordHintOAuth: If two-factor authentication is on for your account, your normal password is refused here — use an app password, or sign in through the server above.

reauth.title: Session expired

offline.window_one: Mail from the last {{count}} day is kept offline.

undoSend.hint: How long a sent message waits before it actually leaves.

signature.label: Signature placement
signature.hint: Where your signature is added when you reply or forward.

identities.title: Identities
identities.description: The addresses you can send from, with the signature and reply-to each one uses. Changes apply to new messages.
identities.empty: This account has no send identities.
identities.protected: Default address — the server does not allow deleting it.

delete.title: Delete identity?
delete.body: {{email}} will no longer be available as a sender address.
delete.draftsWarning: Drafts already written from this address cannot be sent afterwards.

email.label: Email address

replyTo.label: Reply-to
replyTo.hint: Replies go here instead of to the sender address. Separate several addresses with commas.

bcc.label: Automatic Bcc
bcc.hint: Every message sent from this identity is silently copied to these addresses.

htmlSignature.label: Signature
htmlSignature.hint: Inserted into new messages above the quoted text, unless you change the placement under Compose.

textSignature.label: Plain-text signature
textSignature.hint: Used when a message is sent as plain text. It is kept separate, so a signature written by hand is not overwritten.

filters.title: Filters
filters.intro: Rules the server runs on incoming mail, before it reaches you. They keep working when this app is closed.
filters.unsupportedExtensions: This server did not list support for: {{list}}. Rules using them may not run.

foreign.explain: This mailbox already has a filter script that was not written here. It is shown as it is, and is left untouched.
foreign.adoptHint: Your existing rules are kept and go on running. New rules are added after them.

error.invalidSieve: The server rejected the script as invalid. Your rules were not saved.
error.tooLarge: The script is too large for this server.
error.offline: Filters can only be changed while online.
error.rejected: The server declined to save the filters.
error.generic: The filters could not be saved.

server.title: Server
server.description: What this JMAP server offers. Useful when reporting a problem.
server.coreMissing: This server advertises no standard capability object. That is unusual — some features may not work.
server.mailMissing: This account advertises no mail capability, so no mail limits can be shown.

generate.title: Deployment configuration
generate.intro: Generate the config.json for this deployment, describing the server you are signed in to. Save it next to index.html.

finding.sameOrigin: The mail server is on this same origin, so config.json leaves sessionUrl empty — the deployment keeps working if it moves to another hostname.
finding.crossOrigin: The mail server is on {{origin}}, a different origin from this app. Every request depends on that server sending CORS headers. It does today; the deployment will break if that changes.
finding.basicOnly: OAuth discovery did not answer, so only password sign-in is enabled. A password is sent on every request and cannot be revoked for one client alone — enable OAuth on the server if you can.
finding.oauthUnknown: OAuth discovery could not be checked from here, so the sign-in methods are left as they are. Verify them before deploying.
finding.insecureOrigin: This app is served over plain HTTP. Browsers then withhold crypto.subtle, so OAuth cannot run and the offline cache cannot be encrypted. Serve it over HTTPS.
finding.brandingUntouched: Branding, features and offline limits were carried over unchanged — no server can tell us what you want them to be. Edit them by hand.

notify.title: Notifications
notify.description: {{product}} notifies you about new mail whenever it is running — including in a background tab or window.

permission.denied: Your browser is blocking notifications for this site. Allow them in your browser's site settings, then reload {{product}}.
permission.dismissed: Notifications were not allowed. Turn the switch on again to be asked once more.

quiet.label: Quiet hours
quiet.hint: No notifications between these times. A range that crosses midnight is allowed.

preview.label: Show sender and subject
preview.hint: When off, a notification only says that new mail arrived — useful on a shared screen.

sound.label: Play a sound
sound.hint: Whether a sound is actually played is up to your operating system.

background.unavailable: Notifications while {{product}} is fully closed are not available with this server. They need the server to publish a Web-Push signing key (RFC 9749); this one does not. Everything above works whenever {{product}} is open.
background.available: This server can also notify you while {{product}} is closed.
background.contentless: Those notifications say only that mail arrived — never the sender or the subject — and the folder setting above does not apply to them.
background.renewal: Open {{product}} at least once a week to keep them coming: this server renews the background subscription for seven days at a time, and only {{product}} itself can renew it.
